description: Election Commission - J. G. G. Shantha was selected as the member of the Yatawatta Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Yatawatta Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement according to electoral procedures. This falls squarely under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it involves electoral matters and procedures for local authorities.
